title: RD lookup href/ep filters must use RFC 6690 exact-or-trailing-*
description: lookup_resources treats href as raw str.startswith (so href=/stat matches /status, and href=/status* misses /status). ep is exact equality only, so ep=sensor* misses sensor-42. RFC 9176 s6.2 / RFC 6690 s4.1: a criterion matches if the value is bitwise equal, or the query ends with * and is a prefix of the value. rt already does this via _rt_matches. Duplicate Uri-Query keys currently last-wins; they MUST AND. Unknown link-attribute query keys (if, ct, ...) are ignored instead of failing the AND. Fix the matcher and lock it with tests; do not keep startswith without *.
close_reason: RFC 6690 matcher: href/ep use exact-or-trailing-*; duplicate query keys AND; unknown attributes fail AND. Tests: test_lookup_filter_href_exact_does_not_prefix, trailing_star, ep_trailing_star, duplicate_rt_is_and, unknown_attribute_fails_and. pytest 74 passed, 2 pre-existing xfail.
